name: wechat-mini-program-platform-skill
description: Analyze WeChat Mini Program platform constraints and evidence layers for an idea or existing repository, including source configuration, build output, WeChat DevTools loading, device behavior, permissions, privacy declarations, cloud or backend linkage, upload, trial, review, and production status. Use when users ask about WeChat-specific configuration, project roots, compile paths, capability permissions, privacy compliance, official platform rules, upload or release readiness, or why source and platform behavior differ. Performs read-only evidence classification by default, verifies time-sensitive or high-risk claims against current official WeChat sources, redacts identifiers and secrets, and never upgrades one evidence layer into another.
